title: Gritt Cleaning Products by Leatt
content:
Leatt, the South African brand behind some stellar mountain bike protective wear and clothing, has joined the bike-cleaning game with their new brand: Gritt. Given that so much of their catalog contains gear to help you ride in the grime, it’s likely they know a thing or to about cleaning up when you get home. Read below for all the dirty details.

For over 20 years, Leatt has built its reputation for performance and innovation by protecting riders in the toughest conditions. Now, the company is bringing that same focus to protecting bikes with the launch of Gritt by Leatt – a new, premium range of cleaning, maintenance, and protection products designed to keep every ride – motorized or pedal-powered – performing at its best.

Gritt combines superior performance with industry-leading value, ensuring every bike gets the care it deserves. The comprehensive range includes bike wash, bike shine, chain lubricants, degreasers, tubeless sealant, and complete product care solutions for bicycles and beyond.

Every Gritt product has been rigorously tested in the lab, on a wide variety of bikes and across multiple materials. Professional athletes have also put each formula through real-world conditions to guarantee performance you can trust. All products are safe for use on chrome, carbon, anodized metals, and plastics.

Gritt’s Products use a variety of formulas and technologies:

  • Anti-corrosion additives protect metal components from rust and wear, extending their lifespan.
  • Advanced Ceramic Technology creates a durable, exceptionally smooth protective coating that helps repel contaminants, reduces metal-to-metal friction, and extends chain life.
  • Hexagonal Boron Nitride (h-BN) significantly reduces wear and friction, delivering more efficient power transfer, a quieter drivetrain, and long-lasting, smooth performance even in demanding riding conditions.
  • Gritt cleaning products are formulated for increased viscosity (ViscoClean) to cling to any surface, allowing them to work more effectively.
  • Many of Gritt’s products have ‘Shake To Activate’ technology – the products will combine upon shaking, and liquids will transform into liquid gels for less run-off.
  • Next-Gen polymers leave a smart protective layer that helps water and dirt slide off more effectively.

Sustainability is also at the core of the Gritt range. Every ingredient in the TrueBIO formulation has been carefully selected to naturally break down in the environment, leaving nothing harmful behind. Finished with a distinctive cherry scent, Gritt delivers not only performance and protection, but an enhanced maintenance experience riders will appreciate.

All bottles are made from fully recyclable rPET and were specially developed for Gritt to provide better grip, improved usability and a premium shelf appearance.

With Gritt, Leatt extends its innovations beyond the care of riders and into the care of bikes. Advanced technologies, sustainable formulations, and real-world performance set a new standard for bike care, helping riders get even more from every ride.

Gritt by Leatt is available to order now.
